title: share product SEED-Share-Product: unit price 100.00 and share capital 100000.00
_note: share-product seam, PRODUCT DETAIL READ-BACK. request.unit_price "100.00" is share-product-detail-raw.json unitPrice, the exact decimal text the oracle stored; expect.unit_price_minor "10000" is its minor-unit form. request.share_capital "100000.00" is shareCapital (issued 1000 shares * 100.00) and expect.share_capital_minor "10000000" its minor-unit form. request.total_shares 1000 is totalShares. No rounding surface: every product figure is an exact 2dp decimal transcribed to integer minor units. A port that serialises unit price into the share-capital field (or vice versa) goes red, as does one that rounds any money cell up by a minor unit.
